claim-before-kill.summary: a worker is killed as it is about to claim

claim-before-commit-kill.summary: a worker is killed with its claim written but not committed

claim-before-commit-drop.summary: the connection drops with a claim written but not committed

claim-before-commit-hang.summary: a worker hangs for good with its claim written but not committed

claim-after-commit-kill.summary: a worker is killed just after its claim commits

claim-after-commit-drop.summary: a claim commits, but its answer never reaches the worker

start-after-commit-kill.summary: a worker is killed just after it marks the job running

heartbeat-before-stop.summary: a worker is paused mid-task until well past its lease

heartbeat-before-drop.summary: the connection drops mid-task, as the lease is extended

publish-before-commit-kill.summary: a worker is killed with its result written but not committed

publish-before-stop.summary: a worker is paused well past its lease after its job ran, before it publishes

publish-before-commit-stop.summary: a worker is paused well past its lease with its result written but not committed

publish-before-commit-hang.summary: a worker hangs for good with its result written but not committed

publish-before-commit-drop.summary: the connection drops with a result written but not committed

publish-after-commit-kill.summary: a worker is killed just after its result commits

publish-after-commit-drop.summary: a result commits, but its answer never reaches the worker

release-before-commit-kill.summary: a worker is killed giving back a job whose runner crashed, before the commit

reap-before-commit-kill.summary: a worker is killed reaping lapsed leases, before the commit

cancel-before-commit-kill.summary: a worker is killed ending a cancelled job, before the commit

api-submit-after-commit-kill.summary: the api is killed after a batch commits, before it answers

postgres-restart.summary: Postgres stops the way a crash would and starts again, mid-batch

agent-heartbeat-before-kill.summary: a worker is killed mid-task, running the real agent on recorded tasks

agent-publish-before-commit-kill.summary: a worker is killed with an agent's result written but not committed

container-heartbeat-before-kill.summary: a worker is killed mid-task while its job runs in a container of its own

container-publish-before-commit-kill.summary: a worker is killed with a container's result written but not committed
